artifact.category_tag: dual graded graphs and towers of groups
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G:\{e\}=G_0\subset G_1\subset G_2\subset\cdots$ be a tower of finite groups (each $G_n$ a subgroup of $G_{n+1}$), and fix $r\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$. Define the splitting diagram $P=P(G)$ to be the graded graph whose vertices on level $n$ are (isomorphism classes of) irreducible complex representations of $G_n$, with an edge of weight $m$ from an irreducible $\lambda$ of $G_n$ to an irreducible $\mu$ of $G_{n+1}$ whenever $\lambda$ appears in the restriction of $\mu$ to $G_n$ with multiplicity $m$ (equivalently, by Frobenius reciprocity, whenever $\mu$ appears in $\mathrm{Ind}_{G_n}^{G_{n+1}}\lambda$ with multiplicity $m$).

Recall that a graded graph $P$ is $r$-dual (a self-dual graded graph with differential degree $r$) if its up and down operators $U,D$ on the free vector space spanned by vertices satisfy $DU-UD=r\cdot I$. Call the tower $G$ $r$-dual if $P(G)$ is a self-dual graded graph with differential degree $r$. Call the tower $G$ $r$-differential if it is $r$-dual and additionally all edge weights of $P(G)$ are equal to $1$ (so that $P(G)$ is an $r$-differential poset in the sense of Stanley).

Let $Y$ denote Young's lattice (the $1$-differential poset of integer partitions ordered by inclusion of Young diagrams), let $Y^{\otimes r}$ denote the $r$-fold tensor product of $Y$ with itself (an $r$-differential poset), and let $dY$ denote the dilation of $Y$ in which every edge multiplicity is multiplied by $d$. For a finite group $H$, let $H\wr S_n$ denote the wreath product of $H$ with the symmetric group $S_n$.

Prove the following:

(a) If $G$ is $r$-differential, then $P(G)\cong Y^{\otimes r}$ and there exists an abelian group $A$ of order $r$ (not depending on $n$) such that $G_n\cong A\wr S_n$ for all $n\ge 0$.

(b) If $G$ is $r$-dual, then $P(G)\cong (d_1 Y)\times\cdots\times(d_k Y)$ for some positive integers $d_1,\dots,d_k$, and there exists a group $H$ of order $r$ (not depending on $n$) such that $G_n\cong H\wr S_n$ for all $n\ge 0$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Gaetz (Electronic Journal of Combinatorics, 2019), is verified for $r=1$ and for $r$ prime, but appears to remain open in general. No published proof of the full conjecture for arbitrary $r$ was located.

status_evidence.title: Dual graded graphs and Bratteli diagrams of towers of groups
status_evidence.snippet: When r is one or prime, wreath products of a fixed group with the symmetric groups are the only r-dual tower of groups, and the conjecture is that this is the case for general values of r.
status_evidence.claim: Gaetz proves the conjecture for r=1 and r prime; the general case is conjectural.

status_evidence.title: [1803.11168] Dual graded graphs and Bratteli diagrams of towers of groups
status_evidence.snippet: r-dual tower of groups; conjecture that wreath products of a fixed group with symmetric groups are the only such towers.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is stated in Gaetz's paper, with partial results.
